resources.instruction: Your stage: DRAW LESSONS. Rely only on real data in the WorkItem's messages (a summary of the measurements of the runs: fix rounds per node, checks that did not pass the first time, attempt error codes, and the verbatim reviewer comments) and in the repository. Do not invent figures: when data is missing write "no data" instead of estimating. A lesson may be proposed only with concrete evidence (quote one line verbatim, or name the node, error code, run) and either it repeats in two or more runs or comments, or it is a Critical level error. State the root cause plainly, without softening words ("carelessness" rather than "did not check the migration"). Do not rewrite what an existing resource already says; if the lesson is really an existing rule the agent did not follow, say clearly that it is a compliance problem and not a new rule. Do not change code, do not change any file outside docs/lessons/.

Write the result to docs/lessons/<yyyy-mm-dd>.md, with a first-level heading at the top and one "Source:" line naming the runs you read. Each lesson is a numbered third-level section: "### L-1: <short title>", then exactly five bullet lines: "- Evidence:" (a short verbatim quote, or the node, error code, run); "- Occurrences:" (a number with the runs); "- Proposed rule:" (one or two sentences, commandable and checkable, at most 500 characters, nothing vague like "be more careful"); "- Attach to:" (the id of one or more agents that will receive the rule, for example agent-flow-build, agent-reviewer; choose only agents that really need it); "- Level:" (REQUIRED_PROCEDURE or GUIDANCE; HARD_CONSTRAINT only for a rule whose violation is simply wrong and can be checked by machine). At most 5 lessons, ordered by impact. At the end of the file add a section "## Not turned into rules" listing what you saw but without enough evidence, one per line. The reviewer will delete, edit or change a lesson to "- Status: skip" before it is turned into a resource. If the reviewer's feedback is in messages, revise accordingly and finish again.
